page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7se.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Enhanced family, running on a KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base clock of 2.9 GHz. Compute resources include 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 2 physical cores with 2 threads per core. Cache configuration comprises 48 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 48 MB L3 cache. Memory capacity totals 16.0 GB, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware instruction flags include AVX, AVX-512 (including AVX512-VNNI), AES, VAES, and SHA-NI. The server includes no GPUs and no local storage, relying entirely on network-attached storage, with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark outcomes show reliable single-threaded compute but restricted multi-core throughput due to the low overall core count. Single-core evaluations, including stress-ng at 1879.48 and Geekbench at 1556.0, rank within the middle 50% tier, supported by decent gzip compression rates of 27.8 GB/sec and bzip3 decompression at 10.59 GB/sec. Conversely, multi-threaded metrics such as the stress-ng multi-core score of 3870.6, Geekbench multi-core score of 3338.0, and PassMark CPU score of 5868.95 position in the bottom 25%. Memory throughput reaches 30.13 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 24.19 GB/sec for writes. Workload-specific benchmarks reflect these limitations, with Redis SET throughput hitting 3.82 million operations per second and static web serving reaching 6.17 GB/sec.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g7se.xlarge serves entry-to-intermediate enterprise tiers that require dedicated core stability rather than burstable allocations. The primary tradeoff lies in the absence of bundled local NVMe storage and the low baseline networking throughput of 2 Gbps, which caps data transfer limits. This instance is best suited for small-to-midsize relational databases, backend application services, microservices, continuous integration tasks, and moderate web serving layers that do not encounter extreme multi-threaded loads.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7se.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine equipped with an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs (2 physical cores), 16.0 GB of memory (4.0 GB per vCPU), and a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. The instance includes no local storage or dedicated GPUs, relying entirely on network-attached volumes. Performance benchmarks position single-core capability in the middle 50% tier, while multi-core metrics sit within the lower 25% bracket due to the four-vCPU ceiling. Memory bandwidth achieves 30.13 GB/sec for uncached reads and 24.19 GB/sec for writes. The ecs.g7se.xlarge represents an enterprise entry-level server balanced for stable, unconstrained core access. It is appropriate for small-to-midscale application services, moderate web serving, CI/CD pipelines, and lightweight relational databases.
